explainer.title: What is basal body temperature?
explainer.p1: Basal body temperature is your temperature at full rest. Take it every morning before getting out of bed, at the same time, with a two-decimal thermometer.
explainer.p2: After ovulation, progesterone raises your temperature by about 0.2–0.5 degrees. The coverline is the highest of the 6 readings before that rise; three days in a row above it confirms the shift.
explainer.p3: This chart shows ovulation after it happens and is not a method of contraception. Fever, short sleep or alcohol can shift the numbers.
